description: Defines data structures, types, and function prototypes for managing OpenType objects in the FreeType project, specifically related to CFF (Compact Font Format) objects such as driver, size, glyph slot, internal data, transformations, and face/driver functions.
external_methods: FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_size_request( FT_Size size, FT_Size_Request req )
FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_size_select( FT_Size size, FT_ULong strike_index )
FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_face_init( FT_Stream stream, FT_Face face, FT_Int face_index, FT_Int num_params, FT_Parameter* params )

classes.name: CFF_SizeRec
classes.description: Handle to an OpenType size object, containing a root size and strike index.

classes.name: CFF_GlyphSlotRec
classes.description: Handle to an OpenType glyph slot, including hinting and scaling info.

classes.name: CFF_InternalRec
classes.description: Interface to the internal field of FT_Size, managing topfont and subfonts.

classes.name: CFF_Transform
classes.description: Subglyph transformation matrix and offset record.

classes.name: CFF_DriverRec
classes.description: CFF driver class structure with hinting engine, stem darkening, and darken parameters.

methods.name: cff_size_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources for a CFF_Size object.

methods.name: cff_size_request
methods.description: Requests a size for CFF_Size based on parameters.

methods.name: cff_size_select
methods.description: Selects a strike index for embedded bitmaps if option enabled.

methods.name: cff_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a CFF face object from a stream.

calls: FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_size_request( FT_Size size, FT_Size_Request req )
FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_size_select( FT_Size size, FT_ULong strike_index )
FT_LOCAL( FT_Error ) cff_face_init( FT_Stream stream, FT_Face face, FT_Int face_index, FT_Int num_params, FT_Parameter* params )
